description: Hand the customer to the e-eSIM shop to buy one plan. Returns buy_url (the product page where they tap Buy now and pay securely — card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal; there is no discount-code field) plus the plan name and price in the customer's bucket or currency. No account needed; the eSIM is emailed right after payment. There is no in-chat order tracking.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. "en-gb", "de-de". Wins over language; prices and links are quoted in it.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code. Every price in the result is quoted in it.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Plan names and country names come back in it when available. Bare "en" is quoted in en-us / USD.

name: start_checkout

app_links.description: Optional store links of the free e-eSIM app (android, ios) - the eSIM works without it.

buy_url.description: The exact product page to send the customer to. Use verbatim.

price.description: FULL fixed price of the plan.

title: Start secure checkout
